name: Cable High Fly (standing high-to-low cable chest fly)
camera: Side three-quarter view facing right, showing athlete standing between dual high cable pulleys
equipment: Dual high cable pulley stations with single D-handles
positionA: Left panel: Athlete stands in athletic staggered stance with slight forward torso lean (~15-20 degrees), arms abducted high and wide holding D-handles at chest/shoulder level with elbows softly unlocked (full chest stretch at start).
positionB: Right panel: EXACT SAME staggered stance, torso angle, and cable towers. Athlete sweeps both arms downward and forward in a wide hugging arc until hands meet at waist level in front of hips, squeezing lower pectorals; fixed soft elbow bend maintained throughout.
mechanics: Shoulder horizontal adduction in a high-to-low downward arc. Torso and hips stay braced and stationary throughout.

name: Dumbbell Single-Leg Calf Raise (unilateral standing calf raise)
camera: Side three-quarter view facing right, showing athlete standing on a raised calf block holding a dumbbell on the working side
equipment: Raised calf block or step, one dumbbell, and sturdy upright post for balance
positionA: Left panel: Athlete stands tall on ball of working right foot on edge of block with right heel hanging off in deep dorsiflexion (calf stretch), right hand holding dumbbell at side, non-working left foot hooked behind right ankle in the air, left hand lightly touching post for balance.
positionB: Right panel: EXACT SAME single-leg stance. Athlete presses through the ball of the working right foot into full plantar flexion (tiptoe extension), raising heel high; working knee remains softly extended; non-working left foot MUST remain hooked behind right ankle hovering completely in the air (NEVER place left foot on block); dumbbell held stationary at side.
mechanics: Unilateral ankle plantar flexion against dumbbell load. Working knee stays softly extended without flexing.
avoid: NEVER place non-working left foot on the block in either panel (left foot stays airborne/hooked behind right ankle), do not bend working knee into a squat, no swinging dumbbell, no extra limbs, no text/labels/arrows.
